node.text:
Really getting excited about going back to Hamburg, and to Container Days! 

If you're not tired of listening to us yet, Awar and myself are going to talk about security in your MCP servers and agents. How is it possible to even secure access to any servers or tools if you're not controlling the endpoints? 

We expect everyone to be awake and ready at the conference's last morning! 

#powerofsharing #mcp #ai

I'm doing the final sprint before summer vacation! 

This weekend I'll be meeting up with my amazing friends at @DevOpsDays Kraków! These are people I sincerely call my friends. Just too bad we are not able to meet more often. But you are an amazing bunch, and I am really looking forward to see you guys! I'll be talking about AI in DevOps - not just slapping an agent on your documentation, or add Claude to your project. But how you assistant can help you in the DevOps process.

Next week allready, I'll be heading straight to Berlin, and @WeAreDevelopers World Congress. It's kind of a tiny bit larger than the community event in Krakow, with about 15 000 attendees, 500+ speakers and 20+ stages. I am humble, but really really excited as well! Here I'll totally change gears, and talk about memory management in Go! 

Do I see you in Krakow or Berlin the next days? Send me a dm!

I am so happy that I am able to travel around, talking about the topics I care about. And also so happy to have an employer that let's me! Not so happy about the mid-sentence pictures, but I have come to the conclusion that's just how I look at conference photos 😏 

Thank you for giving me these opportunities, both the ones inviting me, and the ones letting me. And to all the people I meet: thank you for making it memorable. And especially now @Cloud Native Days Romania - which was one of this year's absolute top experiences! I have allready bragged so much about you guys, and I hope I'll see you again next year! 

@Awar Abdulkarim is a great friend and travel companion. @Eirik Holgernes is a great manager that believes in me, and @Sopra Steria is a great place to develop myself, and making so many amazing connections 😊 

#SharingIsCaring #PowerOfSharing #NotPhotogenic
